training.loss: L1 on unclipped outputs; inner 128x128 of 138x138 input patch
training.monitoring: both curves use full-image center 256x256 L1 after clipping predictions
training.checkpoint_rule: minimum validation monitoring L1, including epoch 0; earliest on exact ties
training.architecture: five 3x3 convolutions: 2-32-32-32-32-1, ReLU after first four; residual sum
training.initialization: PyTorch default hidden layers; zero final convolution
training.noise: one fixed realization per source; seed 100000+ID

budget_reason: 30 epochs based on pilot timing; no early stopping, no post-test tuning, fresh initialization

evaluation.statistics: per-original-image scores and arithmetic means; paired CNN minus Wiener deltas
evaluation.failure_example_rule: minimum per-image PSNR delta CNN minus Wiener; source ID breaks ties; include even if every delta is positive

limitations: synthetic observations from sRGB-derived scene proxies
